lines.text: 54 STAT.]        76TH CONG., 3D SESS.—CHS. 877–879—OCT. 14, 1940
Section 12, strike out subsection (k) and substitute the following:
Retirement of designated officers.
“(k) Lieutenant commanders and lieutenants with date of rank as
such prior to June 23, 1938, and lieutenants (junior grade) who on
that date were carried as additional numbers in grade by reason of
not having been recommended for promotion, shall, at their own
request, in lieu of honorable discharge as provided in subsection (c)
of this section, be retired on June 30 of the fiscal year in which they
fail of selection as best fitted the second time or on June 30 of the
fiscal year in which they complete the period of service designated
in the Act of March 3, 1931, as amended (U. S. C., title 34, Supp.
III, secs. 286a and 286i), whichever date shall be later with retired
Provisos.
pay computed as provided in subsection (b) of this section: Pro-
Ineligibility for promotion.
vided, That any officer retained on the active list pursuant to this
subsection shall be ineligible for consideration for promotion by sub-
Advancement of lieutenants with specified service.
sequent selection boards: Provided further, That lieutenants who
served in the Navy or Naval Reserve Force prior to November 12,
1918, and who shall have completed not less than twenty-one years
of service, and who subsequent to June 23, 1938, have been or shall
hereafter be retired under any provision of law, shall be advanced
to the grade of lieutenant commander on the retired list effective
from date of retirement with the retired pay of that grade.”
Section 14, in line 9 of subsection (a), after “grade” insert “with
probationary appointments”.
Approved, October 14, 1940.
